product.title: Wagvive Slow Feeder Bowl
product.body_html:
Slower meals, healthier digestion.

A ridged interior design turns mealtime into a gentle challenge, slowing down fast eaters to reduce bloating, gulping, and post-meal discomfort. A simple daily habit that supports better digestion, especially for senior pets or breeds prone to eating too quickly.

  • Reduces bloating and gulping
  • Supports healthy digestion
  • Non-slip base keeps bowl in place
  • Dishwasher-safe
